messages:
Priya: Heads up — final-round SRE interview on Fri 3/20. Need panel confirm and rubric owners. @Sam @Jordan @Alex please confirm availability and which section you'll own. Candidate starts 3:30pm PT. Calendar invite pending.

Sam: I can do 3:30–4:15, happy to take system design + oncall questions. :+1:

Jordan: I can do behavioral and company-fit; schedule conflict at 3:30–3:45, I can join from 3:50 onward. If that’s a hard start we can swap in @Casey for the beginning. Also quick rubric q: how strict on 'pager escalation' scenario? brand-new hires should know triage steps or we give hints?

Alex: I can cover coding and a short take-home discussion. Prefer start at 3:45 so Jordan can join. On 'pager escalation' — I'd weigh error prioritization/communication more than tooling specifics. 20% ops seems fair.

Priya: Ok — tentative weights: system design 30%, coding 30%, behavioral 20%, ops/oncall 20%. I'll update rubric doc: https://internal.redwood.com/rubrics/sre-final (please edit the 'ops' section with examples).

RecruiterBot: Event created: SRE final — Fri 3/20 3:45pm-4:30pm PT. Calendar invites sent to Priya, Sam, Jordan, Alex. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Quick ask — do we want a dedicated scribe for debrief? If not, I can capture notes.

Jordan: Yes please, Sam — capture answers to the two priority prompts and a short score field. Use the debrief template: paste this into the note: ```Candidate: [name]
Top strengths:
Top risks:
Scores (sys/coding/behav/ops): 
One-line summary/reco:```

Priya: Assigning debrief scribe to Sam. Also reminder to use the rubric anchors in the doc when scoring. Small ask: if you deviate +/-1 from anchor, add a 1-sentence rationale.

Alex: Got it. One more — will we do live coding in CoderPad? I'll prep a 25-min problem and share link.

Priya: CoderPad link expected by EOD Thu. If you can't, ping me and I'll host. Thanks all :heart:

Jordan: Also flagging: please mute notifications and join 5 min early so we can sync on timing. (reacts: :thumbsup: by Sam)
